description: This file declares the interface for interacting with a file system monitor daemon via inter-process communication (IPC). It includes functions to check support, retrieve the daemon's IPC path, determine daemon status, send queries for changed files, and send commands to the daemon.
external_methods: simple-ipc.h functions (implied, e.g., for connection handling)

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__is_supported
methods.description: Checks if the built-in file system monitor daemon is supported on the current platform.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__get_path
methods.description: Retrieves the IPC path (named pipe or Unix domain socket) where the daemon listens, specific to the current worktree.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__get_state
methods.description: Determines whether the daemon process is active and listening.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__send_query
methods.description: Connects to the daemon to request changed files since a given token, spawning the daemon if needed.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__send_command
methods.description: Sends a command verb to the daemon without attempting to start one if it is not running.
